description:
Connect your CMC Markets CFD account to ChatGPT and ask questions about your portfolio, trading activity and the markets. View your positions, balances, watchlists and market data –  all from within ChatGPT.

View your available live and demo CFD accounts, account balances, margin summaries, open positions, exposure, and unrealised profit or loss. Search for markets, retrieve product information, request real-time or delayed prices, analyse historical market data, and generate candlestick charts, directly in ChatGPT. 

This integration is read-only. ChatGPT cannot place, amend or close trades, transfer funds, or make any changes to your CMC Markets account.

Currently only available for CFD accounts.

Information provided through this integration is for informational purposes only and should not be considered personal investment advice or a recommendation to trade. T&Cs apply. 

69% of retail investor accounts lose when money trading CFDs with this provider.

defaultPrompt: Show me my account at a glance
What positions and orders do I currently have?
Search for gold products and show latest prices
